title: Ashgrove CareAssure Premium Waiver While Benefits Are Paid
content:
Billing desk note — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance, ten-pay premiums during a long-term care claim.

> Where the tier provides the premium waiver, ten-pay installments falling due while benefits are being paid are waived. A premium is waived only while the policy status is Claim Active. Each installment is waived at most once. Premiums resume with the first installment due after benefits stop. Waived premiums do not count as premiums paid for the return of premium value or the shortened benefit period.

Every Ashgrove CareAssure tier provides the premium waiver.

**Reading the note**

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Which premiums | Ten-pay installments falling due while benefits are being paid |
| Status required | Claim Active, as the policy record shows it |
| How often per installment | At most once; an installment already waived on the policy for the same due date is not waived again |
| When premiums start again | With the first installment due after benefits stop |
| Effect on values | A waived installment is not a premium paid for the return of premium value or for the shortened benefit period |

A waiver is booked against the approved long-term care claim for the installment's due date, and the paid-to date moves past the waived installment.

**Dated illustration (hypothetical annual-mode ten-pay policy, installments due each 15 June)**

| Event | Date | Policy status | Installment due 15 June 2026 | Installment due 15 June 2027 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim approved | 1 March 2026 | Claim Active | Falls due while benefits are paid: waived | — |
| Benefits stop, claim closes | 10 September 2026 | In Force | — | First installment due after benefits stop: payable |

If the same policy had $18000.00 of installments paid and a further $6000.00 waived, the premiums paid that count toward the return of premium value and the shortened benefit period are $18000.00.
